verdict.rationale: Anytype's docs say you can export content at any time, in Markdown or the Any-Block format, and that you can export all your channels and re-import them into a new identity. That covers whole-base export with at least one open format. missing for 10: evidence on how much structure (Types, properties, links, databases) the Markdown export preserves, clarity on whether Any-Block is an open documented format, and independent or hands-on corroboration of full-base export.
